## Summary

**MOVEH** (Move High-word): Move high-word of a register.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `source → destination` |
| Syntax | `MOVEH Dn,<ea>` |
| Short | Move high-word of a register. |
| Description | Move bits 31 to 16 of a register from or to memory. Size is word. |
| Condition codes | see table |

### Condition codes

| X | N | Z | V | C |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| – | * | * | 0 | 0 |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–8 | `00001110` |
| 1 | 7–6 | Size |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | B |
| 2 | 11 | d |
| 2 | 10–0 | `00000010011` |

- Size = word = 1
- B=data or address-register.
- direction d=1: data to &lt;ea&gt;

### Example

```asm
    moveh    d3,(a1)+
```

```text
dn d3: .. .. .. .. 12 34 56 78
Result:
```

- ea (a1) memory content where a1 points to

```text
12 34 .. .. .. .. .. ..
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no MOVEH. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
